text: DSH Capability Inventory 是面向 Web GUI 的技能与 MCP 总览插件，通过宿主端汇总当前可用技能、MCP 服务器和工具，再由浏览器侧边栏面板展示用途、用法、范围、路径与连接状态。用户可以搜索和筛选条目、编辑或启停文件系统技能、软删除技能、切换 MCP 工具可用状态，并在中文界面翻译英文描述。适合需要在一个界面查看并管理 DSH 技能与 MCP 配置的用户。翻译会调用 DSH 宿主 LLM；不要求插件单独配置 API key。

DSH Capability Inventory adds a Skills and MCP panel to the DSH Web GUI. It lists skills, MCP servers, and tools with descriptions and status. Users can search entries, manage skills and MCP availability, and translate descriptions into Chinese with the host LLM.
想在 DSH 网页里集中查看当前可用的 Skills、MCP 服务器和工具。
有没有办法直接在面板里编辑或启停技能，并切换 MCP 工具状态？
I want a searchable DSH panel to browse skills and MCP servers and translate descriptions into Chinese.
DSH Capability Inventory 的功能「技能与 MCP 总览」：打开 Web 侧边栏面板后，查看汇总的 Skills、MCP 服务器及其工具、描述和状态；可搜索名称或描述并按技能来源筛选。
DSH Capability Inventory 使用中文界面翻译英文技能与工具描述时，会把待翻译文本交给配置的 DSH 宿主 LLM；具体 provider/model 可配置，源码没有固定服务域名。

dsh-capability-inventory README · 简介：一个 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/guoshuai007/dsh-capability-inventory) 插件。宿主端汇总技能与 MCP 数据并提供接口，浏览器端在 Web GUI 里渲染成一张总览面板：每个技能 / MCP 服务器的**用途、用法、范围、路径**一目了然，并可直接管理。

dsh-capability-inventory README · 特性：- **总览**：技能来自官方注册表 + 文件系统扫描（`~/.agents/skills`、`~/.dsh/skills`、项目 `.dsh/skills` 等，同名以注册表为准）；MCP 服务器从 profile 配置树读出，展示 `已连接` / `已配置` 状态与完整工具清单（`mcp__<server>__<tool>`）。
- **管理**
  - 技能：编辑 `SKILL.md`、启用 / 停用、软删除（移到 `.trash-*` 回收站）。
  - MCP：启用 / 停用某个服务器的工具可用状态（保留配置与工具定义本身）。
- **中文内容翻译**：中文界面下用宿主 LLM 把英文描述译为中文，结果**持久化缓存**（默认 `$DSH_HOME/capability-inventory-translations.json`）——打开即显示、不重复翻译；每条可单独「重译」。
- **国际化**：面板文案走 DSH 官方 `locale` 字典，默认跟随全局语言，也可在面板内单独切换。
- **配置校验**：插件配置用 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 校验。运行时仅此一个依赖。

dsh-capability-inventory README · 安装（推荐：npm）：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-capability-inventory
```

重启 `dsh web` 后，左侧边栏会出现 **能力总览**（英文界面下为 *Inventory*）。

dsh-capability-inventory README · 配置：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 插件行上写 `config`（全部可选，经 schemastery 校验）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: capability-inventory
      name: dsh-capability-inventory
      config:

字段与默认值见 `lib/index.js` 导出的 `Config`。

dsh-capability-inventory README · 使用：打开 Web GUI，点左侧边栏 **能力总览**。

| 操作 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 搜索 | 顶部搜索框，按名称 / 描述 / 工具名过滤 |
| 筛选 | 「全部来源」下拉，按技能来源过滤 |
| 快捷定位 | 顶部【技能】【MCP】跳转到对应板块 |
| 管理 | 每张卡片的 **编辑 / 启用·停用 / 删除** |
| 重译 | 每张卡片的 **重译** 强制重翻该条内容 |
| 语言 | 右上「English / 中文」只切面板；默认跟随全局语言 |

接口：`GET /api/capability-inventory/overview`（只读汇总，仅限本机 loopback 访问）。

dsh-capability-inventory README · 本地安装（开发用）：从本地目录链接安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-capability-inventory
```

或手动软链 / junction 到 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-capability-inventory`，然后在 `cordis.patch.yml` 加插件行。

dsh-capability-inventory README · 开发与测试：```bash
node test/check.mjs                          # 宿主端自检（零依赖）
npm install && node test/panel.smoke.mjs     # 面板冒烟测试（需 jsdom）
```
dsh-capability-inventory README · 许可证：[MIT](LICENSE)

dsh-capability-inventory README · What it is：A plugin for [DSH (DeepSeek Harness)](https://github.com/guoshuai007/dsh-capability-inventory). The host half aggregates skills and MCP data and serves an API; the browser half renders a panel in the Web GUI showing each skill / MCP server's **purpose, usage, scope and path**, with inline management.

dsh-capability-inventory README · Features：- **Overview**: skills come from the official registry plus a filesystem scan (`~/.agents/skills`, `~/.dsh/skills`, project `.dsh/skills`, …; registry wins on name collision). MCP servers are read from the profile config tree with `connected` / `configured` status and the full tool list (`mcp__<server>__<tool>`).
- **Management**
  - Skills: edit `SKILL.md`, enable / disable, soft delete (moved to a `.trash-*` folder).
  - MCP: enable / disable a server's tool availability (config and tool definitions are kept).
- **Chinese content translation**: in the Chinese UI, English descriptions are translated by the host LLM and **cached persistently** (default `$DSH_HOME/capability-inventory-translations.json`) — instant on reopen, no repeat calls; each item can be re-translated on its own.
- **i18n**: panel copy uses the official DSH `locale` dictionary and follows the global language by default.
- **Config validation** via `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. That is the only runtime dependency.

dsh-capability-inventory README · Install (recommended: npm)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-capability-inventory
```

Restart `dsh web`; an **Inventory** entry appears in the left sidebar (中文界面下为「能力总览」).

dsh-capability-inventory README · Configuration：Add an optional `config` to the plugin row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (validated by schemastery):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: capability-inventory
      name: dsh-capability-inventory
      config:

See the `Config` export in `lib/index.js` for every field and default.

dsh-capability-inventory README · Usage：| Action | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Search | Top search box filters by name / description / tool name |
| Filter | "All sources" dropdown filters skills by source |
| Quick nav | 【Skills】【MCP】buttons jump to the section |
| Manage | Each card: **Edit / Enable·Disable / Delete** |
| Re-translate | Each card's **Re-translate** forces a fresh translation for that item |
| Language | The "English / 中文" button switches the panel only; it follows the global language by default |
dsh-capability-inventory README · Usage：API: `GET /api/capability-inventory/overview` (read-only, loopback-only).

dsh-capability-inventory README · Local install (for development)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-capability-inventory
```

Or link / junction it into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-capability-inventory` and add the plugin row to `cordis.patch.yml`.

dsh-capability-inventory README · Development & tests：```bash
node test/check.mjs                          # host self-check (zero dependency)
npm install && node test/panel.smoke.mjs     # panel smoke test (needs jsdom)
```
